public_rationale: On July 12, 2023, The New Indian Express reported Dukaan's CEO's statement that adopting an AI chatbot had reduced customer-support costs by 85% [e1]. This is a potential counterexample under a cost-savings reading, but the report does not establish realized profit improvement after relevant costs or sufficiently detailed attribution to generative AI [e1]. It therefore does not settle whether a qualifying non-Klarna profit improvement was publicly documented by March 18, 2024, and this single-company report cannot establish that no qualifying disclosure existed [e1].
limitations: The report does not specify the savings measurement period or reconcile the savings to company profit on an identifiable accounting basis [e1].
The chatbot's technical basis is insufficiently detailed to verify attribution to generative AI [e1].
The report cannot establish the absence of qualifying disclosures across companies or what the author personally found [e1].

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Other than Klarna, the author can find no companies that have integrated generative AI in a way that has truly improved their bottom line.
conditions: as far as the author can find

statement.excerpt: I can find no companies that have integrated generative AI in a way that has truly improved their bottom line other than Klarna,

our_interpretation: Assess the public evidence available to find by publication, rather than the author's private search history.
Bottom line ordinarily means realized profit improvement after relevant costs. A company need not become profitable for its bottom line to improve.
The observation covers the latest completed annual reporting year, 2023, and interim results available through 18 March 2024.
No accounting basis is specified for the general claim. Klarna's separately quoted company estimate does not establish a basis for every other company.
criteria.support_condition: Broad, appropriately scoped financial evidence establishes that no company other than Klarna had publicly documented a realized profit improvement attributable to generative AI integration by publication.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one other company had publicly documented such a realized profit improvement, with the relevant costs and accounting basis identifiable.

evidence.locator: CEO interview, paragraph following the opening paragraph
evidence.explanation: Dukaan's CEO reported an actual expense reduction after adopting a chatbot. This is material counterevidence under a loose cost-savings reading, but the interview does not provide a reconciled company profit effect or a sufficiently detailed technical attribution; no primary financial disclosure was located.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A disclosure available by March 18, 2024 documenting a non-Klarna company's realized profit improvement from generative AI integration during 2023 or the available interim period, with relevant costs and accounting basis identified, would contradict the claim. Support would require sufficiently broad historical evidence establishing that no qualifying public disclosure was available by publication.
